title: L2Settlement Plugin Configuration
description: Configuration for Neo L2 Settlement plugin - manages batch submission to NeoHub on L1

ChainId.description: L2 chain identifier matching Batch plugin

L1RpcEndpoint.description: HTTP/HTTPS endpoint URL for Neo N3/N4 full node RPC interface

ExpectedNetwork.description: Optional network name validation (e.g., 'MainNet', 'PrivateNet') for safety

SettlementManagerHash.description: Neo address of SettlementManager contract in hex format (20 bytes)

ForcedInclusionHash.description: Neo address of ForcedInclusion contract in hex format

SharedBridgeHash.description: Neo address of SharedBridge contract in hex format

L2BridgeHash.description: Neo address of L2 bridge adapter in hex format

MessageRouterHash.description: Neo address of MessageRouter contract in hex format

Enabled.description: Whether settlement client is active and submitting batches
